description: The EU public procurement corpus searchable offline, with contactable leads from contract award winners.

tools.name: notices_search
tools.description: Search TED notices with an expert query (for example buyer-country=DEU AND classification-cpv=45000000 SORT BY publication-date DESC) and choose the returned fields. Query syntax and field names: https://ted.europa.eu/en/search/expert-search. Required: fields, query. Optional: checkQuerySyntax (default: false), iterationNextToken, limit (default: 10) (plus 4 more).

params.name: checkQuerySyntax
params.description: To check the syntax of the query. When the parameter is set to 'true', the syntax of the query is checked, but the search query is not executed.

params.name: fields
params.description: Fields to return for each notice

params.name: iterationNextToken
params.description: Opaque token returned by the previous call to the search endpoint to retrieve the next result page. It shouldn't be provided in PAGE_NUMBER mode or if this is the first request in ITERATION mode.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of returned notices, used to paginate results. You can retrieve up to 250 notices per page, and 10000 fields per page (the number of fields per page corresponds to the size of the 'fields' array multiplied by the value of 'limit').

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number, used to paginate results

params.name: paginationMode
params.description: The PAGE_NUMBER mode allows you to retrieve up to 15000 notices for a given query, using pagination. To retrieve more notices, you can use the ITERATION mode. ITERATION mode does not have limitation on the number of retrievable notices, but you can't choose the page you want to retrieve. The first request will return an iterationNextToken that should be provided to the next call of the search endpoint in order to retrieve the next result page.

params.name: query
params.description: Expert search query to filter and sort notices

params.name: scope
params.description: Search scope (LATEST: only notices of the current OJ S release, ACTIVE: only active notices, ALL: all notices)

novel_features.name: Construction Leads
novel_features.description: Get a contactable outreach list of companies that just won construction contracts: one row per winner with email, phone, city and VAT/HRB id when TED reports them, plus contract value and what is being built.

novel_features.name: Open-tender ranker
novel_features.description: Rank open tenders by deadline urgency, contract value and keyword fit into a prioritized bid shortlist.

novel_features.name: Buyer dossier
novel_features.description: Profile a contracting authority: publishing cadence, CPV mix, typical contract values and repeat winners.

novel_features.name: Market concentration
novel_features.description: See which companies capture what share of awarded value in a sector and country, with an HHI concentration score.

novel_features.name: Winner dossier
novel_features.description: Profile one company that wins public contracts: win timeline, total value, buyers, regions and latest contact data.

novel_features.name: Tender incumbents
novel_features.description: For one open tender, see who previously won contracts from the same buyer in the same category.

novel_features.name: Deadline heat
novel_features.description: A ranked list of tenders closing within days, weighted by urgency, value and how few companies usually win this buyer's awards.

novel_features.name: Buyer award rate
novel_features.description: See per buyer how many calls for tender end in published awards and how many distinct companies win.

novel_features.name: Dark buyers
novel_features.description: Flag contracting authorities whose tenders rarely produce public awards or keep going to one company.

novel_features.name: Procurement velocity
novel_features.description: See whether a procurement market is heating up or cooling off with weekly notice counts versus the same window last year.

novel_features.name: CPV drift
novel_features.description: See which procurement categories grow or shrink year over year in a country's spending mix.
